text: Phase 1 complete: typed scalars, units, designs, validity and evidence ADTs, open capabilities, serializable-shape specs, static compatibility compiler, dynamic typed rejection, and downstream extension seam. Focused inferenceJVM/test and inferenceJS/test pass 22 tests each; compile-time exclusion covers RRR covariance-root misuse, incompatible nulls, and unsupported block designs. compileAll and testAll pass; shared forbidden-import scan and whitespace checks are clean.
